name: AEO Multilingual
description: An SEO/AEO auditing tool that scores each language version of a node independently (0-100) across seven pluggable checks (hreflang, schema markup, meta description, header hierarchy, image alt text, content length, translation completeness) and reports them on an admin dashboard and a per-node tab.

suggests.drupal/schema_metatag: Recommended for JSON-LD schema markup auditing

project_description:
AEO Multilingual optimizes multilingual Drupal sites for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI citations. Unlike traditional SEO modules that treat multilingual content as an afterthought, this module provides independent AEO scoring and recommendations for each language version of your content.

 Key Features 
 
 Per-language AEO audit: Each translation receives an independent score (0-100) based on 7 different checks 
 Hreflang validation: detect missing or incorrect hreflang coverage 
 Schema markup per language: ensure each translation has proper JSON-LD with correct inLanguage attribute 
 Visual dashboard: see AEO scores across all languages at a glance 
 Node-level checklist: detailed recommendations for each language version with actionable suggestions 
 Translation completeness: identify untranslated content that affects AEO performance 
 Meta description validation: check length and presence for each language 
 Header hierarchy analysis: ensure proper H1-H6 structure 
 Image alt text verification: confirm images have descriptive alt text 
 
 As AI-powered answer engines increasingly answer questions directly, traditional SEO is evolving into AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). For multilingual sites, content must be optimized for AI citations in each language independently. This module provides an AEO auditing tool designed for multilingual Drupal sites.

 Recommended companion modules: Metatag (meta description validation) and Schema.org Metatag (schema markup validation).
